integrity.finite_check_scope: All labelled trees on 2..6 vertices and each root, with one heterogeneous rational parameter assignment per rooted structure

scientific_limitations: All tree vertices have strictly positive sampling probability, and every observed channel is independently positively informative.
Only covariance-sign patterns and the unary-contracted event forest are recovered, not all latent parameters or the order along unary chains.
The sampling inequality is a sufficient bound, with no minimax optimality assertion.
Historical priority remains provisional, including incomplete inspection of a related 2002 primary article.
title: Noise-invariant ancestry signatures for randomly sampled event trees
